messages:
natalie: Quick heads up — a small prompt tweak (temp 0.2→0.3) landed in the summarizer PR and preflight showed a clarity regression.

sahil: How bad is "clarity" across the whole suite? noisy or handful of cases?

anya: Quick run: 14/200 prompts regressed, avg clarity delta -3.1%, mostly paraphrase fidelity. Not safety-related. Link: https://internal/reports/eval/248001

mike: If it's localized we could canary at 20% and watch, but QA is leaning pin. Any SLO impact??

natalie: SLOs unaffected. Buyer-facing experience — prefer guardrail. Proposal: 1h manual hold for targeted A/B and decide pin vs exception.

deploybot: deploybot: hold created by natalie — canary suspended. To approve exception react :thumbsup: or reply. Auto-timeout 60m.

luis: +1 for hold. Can we run a focused A/B on the top 50 active users (heavy prompts)?

sahil: Starting targeted eval now (top50 heavy users). ETA ~18m. Logs/results to https://internal/reports/2480

jen: If we pin, infra rollback is trivial — flip prompt variant at routing layer, no restart.

anya: Targeted A/B interim: global avg -2.4%, but for locale `fr` median -4.8%. Looks like translation/paraphrase edge-case.

mike: Decision: hold for 1h. If targeted global regression > 2.5% pin to previous prompt. Assigning sahil+anya to finalize.

natalie: I'll update release notes + the EVAL ticket with this decision and notify PMs. tagging @luis for change-window awareness :eyes:

deploybot: deploybot: hold will auto-escalate to oncall in 45m if unresolved.

sahil: A/B run finishing, will post final stats in 12m.

anya: I'll prep a short rollback summary (what to pin, breadcrumbs, eval snapshot) in the ticket.

mike: Thanks team. Keep thread tidy — if we end up pinning, please include exact prompt SHA and deploybot pin command.
